"""Independent6.25us history against archived12.5us observations.

Reference dynamics are never replayed. Retain each new common endpoint, work,
impulses and changed-event evidence; no claim of missing prior dense coverage.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import sys

BASE=Path('/tmp/a1-body-finer-history-20260927.py')
BASE_SHA='8751eecb97ae1e30449576b567812b810d857be6f9a3fccc16f2a8af69021586'
b=BASE.read_bytes()
if hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()!=BASE_SHA:raise RuntimeError('reviewed history envelope changed')
exec(compile(b.decode().split("\nif __name__=='__main__':",1)[0],'<reviewed no-build envelope>','exec'),globals())
HERE=Path(__file__).resolve()

 'FB-01aj-finer-independent-history-12us.json':'d667ce5b7af1e6292ab59755e70dfe217f75c7015d7d7b7340ba48d052240b7f',
 'FB-01aj-finer-independent-history-12us-d667ce5b7af1.json':'37e66bbaff6332938e94a1d44f71fab176675b4e1f0618520a0b1ede8aaac228',
 'FB-01aj-finer-independent-history-12us-37e66bbaff63.json':'6eccb2b42d3bb73b4d09e3abe273e6e6f887e436f0aa59fab9c78b1f2b2905ba',
 'FB-01aj-finer-independent-history-12us-6eccb2b42d3b.json':'8582e2182c6cb3a74d849ac9d5ffadc4df352cd1e19727f54721946ea003450c',
 'FB-01aj-finer-independent-history-12us-8582e2182c6c.json':'c1e48d99192beffde3b7a954b8cf0938fd440201751294b89b6eb26776479dd6',
 'FB-01aj-finer-independent-history-12us-c1e48d99192b.json':'b251b239e0a2d1e2323337edd6849fd2f7afafe712afb7e1a6453ad5ea255f31',
 'FB-01aj-finer-independent-history-12us-b251b239e0a2.json':'eb87585eecc21ab707cd826069de988bfa135fdd846a39a765be70169307c4ac',
 'FB-01aj-finer-independent-history-12us-eb87585eecc2.json':'f029532a3cfeac03819d399eb57c16dd4f52b662dfff794398edd6a572be519d',
 'FB-01aj-finer-independent-history-12us-f029532a3cfe.json':'a632e187d68d29c6234644a65cfdc2963eca2d9b262d553a97290ff53ece7d85',
 'FB-01aj-finer-independent-history-12us-a632e187d68d.json':'960a5e11c027a8f820802f200c0b035a1f115df4dd6698f4307ac5cd2339e274',
 'FB-01aj-quarter-eighth-continuation.json':'3ee3c7f37099f3e8a5d52e95fe0a092362d5ccef636c7d5613a0a05c53105ed8',
}
SCHEMA_OUT='guala.functional-body.sixteenth-independent-history.v1'
TARGET_NAME='FB-01aj-independent-history-6us.json'
RESUME=None


def diagnostic():
    global CPU_LIMIT,MAX_TRIALS
    b=ACCEPTED.read_bytes()
    require(hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==ACCEPTED_SHA,'observer changed')
    exec(compile(b.decode().split('\nresult=dict(schema=SCHEMA,completed=False',1)[0],
                 '<accepted numerical observer>','exec'),globals())
    CPU_LIMIT,MAX_TRIALS=50.,30000
    result=dict(schema=SCHEMA_OUT,completed=False,failure=None,mounted=False,
        full_body_qualification=False,full_admission_proof=False,continuum_enclosure=False,
        reference_dynamics_replayed=False,
        scope='independent6.25us history from same genesis to365.1ms; archived12.5us reference',
        missing_evidence='comparison before360.6ms is at archived endpoints only; full historical qualification remains OPEN',
        evidence_retention='every new common endpoint/work/impulse plus changed-event stages; duplicate intermediate raw prefix omitted',
        parent_receipt=None if RESUME is None else dict(file=RESUME[0],sha256=RESUME[1]),
        samples=[],endpoints=[],comparisons=[],resumed_inputs=[],release_records=[],
        prior_sample_count=0,prior_cpu_seconds=0.,event_state=None,active_operands=None,active_restore=None,lane=None)
    fine=reference=None;errors=Errors();mj.mj_forward=forward

    def load(name,sha):
        b=Path('docs/evidence',name).read_bytes()
        require(hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==sha,'receipt differs: '+name)
        r=json.loads(b)
        require(r['measurement_recorded'] and r['health_error'] is None and r.get('operational_error') is None
                and r['execution']['exit_code']==0 and not r['execution']['survivors'],'parent execution differs')
        p=r['raw_measurement'];b=zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(p['payload_zlib_base64'],validate=True))
        require(len(b)==p['raw_bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==p['raw_sha256'],'parent payload differs')
        return json.loads(b)

    def impulses(rows):
        def vector(v):
            if isinstance(v,dict):
                require(set(v)=={'shape','finite','float64_le_base64'} and v['shape']==[3] and v['finite'] is True,
                        'packed impulse descriptor differs')
                b=base64.b64decode(v['float64_le_base64'],validate=True)
                require(len(b)==24,'packed impulse size differs');a=np.frombuffer(b,dtype='<f8').copy()
            else:
                require(isinstance(v,list),'plain impulse descriptor differs');a=np.asarray(v,dtype='<f8')
            require(a.shape==(3,) and bool(np.all(np.isfinite(a))),'invalid impulse vector')
            return a
        return {tuple(r['pair']):(vector(r['force']),vector(r['couple']),r['force_path'],r['couple_path']) for r in rows}

    def capture(c):
        a=np.empty_like(c.e._state_buffer);mj.mj_getState(c.m,c.d,a,interval.STATE_KIND)
        return dict(state_base64=raw(a.tobytes()),time_s=float(c.d.time))

    def restore(c,saved,evidence):
        evidence.update(expected_state_base64=saved['state_base64'],expected_time_s=saved['time_s'],completed=False)
        result['active_restore']=evidence
        try:
            b=base64.b64decode(saved['state_base64'],validate=True)
            interval._restore(c.e,np.frombuffer(b,dtype='<f8').copy(),H)
            require(primary(c.e)==b and float(c.d.time)==saved['time_s'],'raw restore differs')
            observation=asdict(c.e._observation());evidence['actual_observation']=observation
            if saved.get('observation') is not None:
                evidence['expected_observation']=saved['observation']
                require(json.dumps(observation,sort_keys=True)==json.dumps(saved['observation'],sort_keys=True),'sensory restore differs')
            c.work=tuple(saved['work']);c.supply=saved['remaining_supply_j'];c.impulses=impulses(saved['impulses'])
            evidence['completed']=True
        finally:
            try:evidence['actual']=capture(c)
            except Exception as error:
                evidence['extraction_error']=repr(error)
                if evidence['completed']:evidence['completed']=False;raise

    def events():
        seq=list(prior_events['sequence']);brackets=list(prior_events['brackets'])
        for row in fine.events:
            require(plain_domain(row['before_domain'])==plain_domain(seq[-1]),'event continuity differs')
            for event in chronological_events(row):
                require(plain_domain(event['before_domain'])==plain_domain(seq[-1]),'event stage continuity differs')
                seq.append(plain_domain(event['after_domain']))
                brackets.append(dict(start_s=event['start_s'],end_s=event['end_s']))
        return dict(time_s=float(fine.c.d.time),sequence=seq,brackets=brackets)

    def endpoint():
        return dict(**capture(fine.c),work=fine.c.work,impulses=radau._record_impulses(fine.c.impulses),
                    remaining_supply_j=fine.c.supply)

    def compare(saved):
        row=dict(time_s=saved['time_s'],reference=saved,actual=endpoint(),completed=False)
        result['active_operands']=row
        restore(reference,saved,row.setdefault('reference_restore',{}))
        try:
            row['actual_observation']=asdict(fine.c.e._observation())
            errors.compare(reference,fine.c,reference.snapshot(),fine.c.snapshot(),saved['time_s']*1e6)
            path=events();old=saved['event_state']
            verdict=radau.trajectory_agreement(fine.c.e,
                dict(snapshot=interval._snapshot(reference.e),work=reference.work,impulses=reference.impulses,
                     sequence=tuple(plain_domain(x) for x in old['sequence']),brackets=old['brackets']),
                dict(snapshot=interval._snapshot(fine.c.e),work=fine.c.work,impulses=fine.c.impulses,
                     sequence=tuple(plain_domain(x) for x in path['sequence']),brackets=path['brackets']),saved['time_s'])
            row.update(verdict=verdict,actual_event_state=path)
            require(verdict['passed'] and errors.first_failure is None and not errors.unresolved_touch['samples'],
                    'independent physical/sensory/work/impulse/event discrepancy')
            row['completed']=True;result['comparisons'].append(row);result['active_operands']=None
        finally:
            if not row['completed']:
                for label,c in (('reference',reference),('fine',fine.c)):
                    try:row[label+'_failed_actual']=capture(c)
                    except Exception as error:row[label+'_extraction_error']=repr(error)

    def release():
        nonlocal prior_events
        c=fine.c;require(float(c.d.time)==.25 and fine.release is None,'release predecessor differs')
        b=primary(c.e);dt=float(c.m.opt.timestep)
        row=dict(time_s=.25,before_base64=raw(b),work_before=c.work,supply_before=c.supply,completed=False)
        result['release_records'].append(row)
        try:
            row['closed_event_state']=events();row['effort_before']=float(c.d.ctrl[c.motor]);c.d.ctrl[c.motor]=0.
            commanded=primary(c.e);row['command_state_base64']=raw(commanded)
            probe.forward(c.e);c.e._check();row['actual']=capture(c)
            require(primary(c.e)==commanded and float(c.d.time)==.25,'release changed state beyond command')
            require(c.work==row['work_before'] and c.supply==row['supply_before'],'release changed work')
            new=dict(time_s=.25,sequence=[plain_domain(interval._snapshot(c.e)['domain'])],brackets=[])
        except BaseException:
            interval._restore(c.e,np.frombuffer(b,dtype='<f8').copy(),dt);row['rollback_exact']=primary(c.e)==b;raise
        fine.release=dict(time_s=.25,before_base64=raw(b),after_base64=raw(commanded))
        row['closed_event_rows']=fine.events;fine.events=[];prior_events=new;row['completed']=True

    try:
        control=archived_controls()[100];fine=Lane('sixteenth',H/16,control);reference=Trajectory(100,control)
        result['genesis_base64']=fine.genesis;result['initial_supply_j']=fine.c.supply
        require(raw(primary(reference.e))==fine.genesis,'reference genesis differs')
        prior_events=dict(time_s=0.,sequence=[plain_domain(interval._snapshot(fine.c.e)['domain'])],brackets=[])
        index={};sample_times=set();prior_reference=None
        for name,sha in PARENTS.items():
            parent=load(name,sha);sample_times.update(parent['samples'])
            if 'lane' in parent:
                l=parent['lane']
                require(l['genesis_base64']==fine.genesis and l['nominal_dt_s']==H/8,'reference history differs')
                require(parent['first_failure'] is None and all(r['completed'] for r in parent['comparisons']),
                        'reference endpoint unsupported')
                saved={k:l[k] for k in ('time_s','state_base64','work','remaining_supply_j','impulses','observation')}
                saved.update(event_state=parent['event_state'],origin=dict(file=name,sha256=sha))
                require(saved['time_s'] not in index,'duplicate endpoint');index[saved['time_s']]=saved
                prior_reference=saved
            else:
                require(prior_reference is not None and prior_reference['time_s']==parent['suffix_start_s'],
                        'reference suffix clock differs')
                first=parent['resumed_inputs'][1]
                require(first['expected_state_base64']==prior_reference['state_base64'] and first['completed'],
                        'reference suffix predecessor differs')
                path=prior_reference['event_state']
                seq=list(path['sequence']);brackets=list(path['brackets'])
                for pair in parent['endpoints']:
                    saved=dict(pair[1]);require(plain_domain(saved['sequence'][0])==plain_domain(seq[-1]),'suffix event discontinuity')
                    seq.extend(saved['sequence'][1:]);brackets.extend(saved['brackets'])
                    saved.update(remaining_supply_j=control['initial_supply_j']-saved['work'][0],
                        event_state=dict(time_s=saved['time_s'],sequence=list(seq),brackets=list(brackets)),origin=dict(file=name,sha256=sha))
                    require(saved['time_s'] not in index,'duplicate suffix endpoint');index[saved['time_s']]=saved
                bad=parent['failed_attempt']['pair_report']['disagreement']
                require(not bad['state_work_impulse_passed'] and bad['same_event_sequence']
                        and bad['paired_event_brackets_within_limit'],'wrong terminal refusal')
                require(plain_domain(bad['fine_sequence'][0])==plain_domain(seq[-1]),'failed suffix event discontinuity')
                seq.extend(bad['fine_sequence'][1:]);brackets.extend(bad['fine_brackets'])
                index[bad['time_s']]=dict(time_s=bad['time_s'],state_base64=bad['fine_state']['float64_le_base64'],
                    work=bad['fine_work'],impulses=bad['fine_impulses'],remaining_supply_j=control['initial_supply_j']-bad['fine_work'][0],
                    event_state=dict(time_s=bad['time_s'],sequence=seq,brackets=brackets),
                    origin=dict(file=name,sha256=sha,kind='actual refused12.5us successor; not accepted truth'))
            del parent
        sample_times.update(index);sample_times.add(.25);result['reference_end_s']=max(index)
        schedule=[];now=0.
        for end in sorted(sample_times):
            while now<end:now=next_sample(now,end);schedule.append(now)
        if RESUME is not None:
            parent=load(*RESUME)
            require(parent['schema']==SCHEMA_OUT and not parent['completed'] and parent['first_failure'] is None,'not an unfinished history')
            require(parent['failure']['type']=='RuntimeError' and parent['failure']['error']==
                    'bounded admitted-motion diagnostic exhausted; qualification incomplete','not a CPU/trial-only stop')
            require(all(r['completed'] for r in parent['comparisons']) and all(r['completed'] for r in parent['release_records']),
                    'prior comparison/release failed')
            saved=parent['lane'];last=saved['last_attempt']
            require(saved['genesis_base64']==fine.genesis and saved['nominal_dt_s']==H/16 and
                    parent['event_state']['time_s']==saved['time_s'],'resume custody differs')
            require((last['completed'] and last['end_s']==saved['time_s']) or (not last['completed'] and last['rollback_exact']
                    and last['predecessor_base64']==saved['state_base64'] and last['start_s']==saved['time_s']
                    and last['supply_j']==saved['remaining_supply_j']),'resume interval lacks rollback custody')
            row={};result['resumed_inputs'].append(row);restore(fine.c,saved,row)
            fine.last_attempt=last;fine.release=saved['release'];prior_events=parent['event_state']
            result['prior_sample_count']=parent['prior_sample_count']+len(parent['samples'])
            result['prior_cpu_seconds']=parent['prior_cpu_seconds']+parent['cpu_seconds']
            errors.groups={k:v['channels'] for k,v in parent['metrics'].items() if 'channels' in v}
            touch=parent['metrics']['local_tactile_correspondence'];errors.unresolved_touch={k:touch[k] for k in ('samples','first','last')}
            errors.matched_touch_points=touch['matched_points'];errors.empty_touch_samples=touch['both_empty_samples']
            errors.couple_impulse=parent['metrics']['intrinsic_couple_impulse']['pairs']
            require(plain_domain(interval._snapshot(fine.c.e)['domain'])==plain_domain(prior_events['sequence'][-1]),'resume domain differs')
        result['event_state']=events()
        if float(fine.c.d.time)==.25 and fine.release is None:release()
        for stop in schedule:
            if stop<=float(fine.c.d.time):continue
            budget();fine.advance(stop)
            # Prefix is observer-only and never read by later dynamics. Keep
            # common raw endpoint/work/impulse plus changed-stage events instead.
            result['endpoints'].append(endpoint());fine.prefix.clear()
            if stop in index:compare(index[stop])
            if stop==.25:release();result['event_state']=events()
            result['samples'].append(stop)
            if len(result['samples'])%100==0:
                print('PROGRESS',json.dumps(dict(time_s=stop,attempts=attempts,cpu_seconds=time.process_time()-started_cpu)),flush=True)
        budget();result['completed']=True
    except Exception as error:
        result['failure']=dict(type=type(error).__name__,error=str(error),traceback=traceback.format_exc(limit=8))
    finally:
        mj.mj_forward=native_forward
        if fine is not None:
            try:
                result['event_state']=events();result['lane']=fine.record()
                require(result['lane']['observation_error'] is None,'terminal observation unavailable')
            except Exception as error:
                result['terminal_extraction_error']=repr(error);result['completed']=False
                try:result['terminal_actual']=capture(fine.c)
                except Exception as extraction:result['terminal_raw_error']=repr(extraction)
                if result['failure'] is None:result['failure']=dict(type=type(error).__name__,error=str(error),phase='terminal_evidence')
        result.update(metrics=errors.result(),first_failure=errors.first_failure,attempts=attempts,calls=probe.calls,
            call_accounting=audit,cpu_seconds=time.process_time()-started_cpu,wall_seconds=time.perf_counter()-started_wall)
    print(json.dumps(encode(result)),flush=True)


if __name__=='__main__':
    if '--resume' in sys.argv:
        at=sys.argv.index('--resume');require(at==len(sys.argv)-3,'resume arguments must be terminal')
        name,sha=sys.argv[at+1:]
        require(Path(name).name==name and name.startswith('FB-01aj-independent-history-6us') and name.endswith('.json')
                and len(sha)==64 and all(c in '0123456789abcdef' for c in sha),'invalid resume custody')
        RESUME=(name,sha);TARGET_NAME='FB-01aj-independent-history-6us-'+sha[:12]+'.json';del sys.argv[at:]
    if sys.argv[1:]==['--child']:diagnostic()
    else:run()
